title: SQL Injection in User Lookup
suggested_virtual_patch: Enforce strict WAF regex/ML blocking on '/vulnerabilities/sqli/' for SQL meta-characters (', ", --, ;, UNION, SELECT, OR 1=1) across query and body parameters; apply parameterised queries in application code. [Active Threat: 2 matching attack event(s) observed in WAF logs.]

title: Local File Inclusion / Path Traversal
suggested_virtual_patch: Block path traversal sequences (../, ..\, %2e%2e%2f, /etc/passwd, win.ini) on '/vulnerabilities/fi/' at the WAF proxy and restrict file access to an allowlisted base directory. [Active Threat: 3 matching attack event(s) observed in WAF logs.]

title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting in Guestbook
suggested_virtual_patch: Enable WAF payload inspection on '/vulnerabilities/xss_s/' to block HTML/JS injection vectors (<script>, onerror=, onload=, javascript:) and enforce Content-Security-Policy and output HTML encoding. [Proactive Hardening: 0 active attacks observed so far.]

title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
